nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to a specific composition without more scouting information. Do not neglect scouting to detect early pressure or tech switches.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue developing your economy and tech, strengthen your ground army, and maintain a defensive posture. Consider adding production structures to support a larger army.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have more information about enemy composition (e.g., scouting their tech or army). If you see signs of an early push, adjust your defense accordingly.

nodes.title: Early-Midgame Ground Macro with Heavy Tech
nodes.transition_goal: Reach a solid midgame position with a strong economy, tech, and a capable ground army. Be ready to adapt to enemy composition.
nodes.trigger_summary: At around 240-300 seconds, you have a heavy economy and production, with a ground-oriented army (Marines, possibly Reapers) and heavy technology investment. Enemy intelligence is uncertain but suggests a possible ground or unknown posture with heavy economy and tech.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid continuing to expand and tech without reinforcing your army. Do not assume the enemy is passive.
nodes.decision_direction: Balance your economy and tech investment with defensive measures. Ensure you have enough army to defend against a potential push. Consider adding defensive structures or units.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have scouted the enemy's army composition and intentions. If you see a large army moving out, prepare to defend.
nodes.next_state_summary: Adjust your build to include more defensive units or structures, while continuing to develop your economy and tech.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy has a heavy economy and production, with a ground army (Stalkers). They are likely to have a similar army strength, and could be planning an attack.
nodes.own_situation: You are heavily invested in economy and tech, with a ground army (Marines, Reapers). Your defense is moderate, but you may be vulnerable to a timing attack.
nodes.strategic_reason: Over-committing to economy while neglecting defense can lead to a game-ending loss if the enemy attacks. A moderate defense may not be enough against a well-timed push.
nodes.title: Risk of Over-Expansion Without Defense
nodes.transition_goal: Reach a safer position where you can defend against early aggression while maintaining your macro lead.
nodes.trigger_summary: At around 300 seconds, you have a heavy economy and production, but your defense is only moderate. Enemy is on a ground macro posture with heavy production and tech, and may be preparing a push.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid neglecting your ground army while transitioning. Do not over-invest in air without a clear reason.
nodes.decision_direction: Consider transitioning to a more versatile composition by adding air units (e.g., Medivacs, Vikings) and increasing your tech. This will give you more options against potential enemy compositions.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have more information about enemy composition. If you see a heavy air threat, prioritize anti-air.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue developing your army and tech, with a focus on flexibility and adaptation.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy is on a ground macro posture with heavy production and tech. They have Stalkers and are likely to have a similar army strength.
nodes.own_situation: You have a solid ground army (Marines, Reapers) and heavy production and tech. Your economy is strong, and you are looking to expand your options.
nodes.strategic_reason: Adding air units and tech increases your flexibility and can counter certain Protoss compositions (e.g., Colossus, Void Rays). It also allows for better map control and harassment.
nodes.title: Midgame Tech and Air Transition
nodes.transition_goal: Achieve a balanced army with both ground and air components, and a tech advantage.
nodes.trigger_summary: At around 300-360 seconds, you have a strong ground army and heavy tech. Enemy is on a ground macro posture, but you are considering increasing your air presence and tech.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to tech at the expense of army production. Do not neglect scouting.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue your economic and tech development, while maintaining scouting to detect any early aggression. Consider adding production structures to support a larger army.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have more information about enemy intentions. If you see an early push, adjust your build.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue macro development, with a focus on economy and tech.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy is also investing heavily in economy and tech, with no clear army composition yet. Their production is moderate.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and tech, with moderate production. Your army is small (Reapers) and you are focused on development.
nodes.strategic_reason: A strong economy and tech lead in the early game sets you up for a powerful midgame. Scouting is crucial to avoid being caught off guard.
nodes.title: Early Game Economy and Tech Focus
nodes.transition_goal: Reach the early-midgame with a solid economy, tech, and a small but capable army.
nodes.trigger_summary: At around 180 seconds, you are in the early game with a heavy economy and tech investment. Enemy is unknown but likely on a similar path.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being too passive and allowing the enemy to dictate the pace. Do not neglect scouting to detect drops.
nodes.decision_direction: Strengthen your ground army and maintain your air support. Consider adding defensive structures or units to counter potential drops. Continue teching up.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have scouted the enemy's army composition and intentions. If you see a large army, prepare for a fight.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue developing your army and tech, with a focus on defense and map control.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy has a heavy economy and production, with a ground army (Stalkers, Warp Prisms). They may be planning to use Warp Prism drops or harassment.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production, with a ground army and moderate air presence (Medivacs). Your defense is moderate, and you are expanding.
nodes.strategic_reason: Warp Prism drops can be very effective, so you need to be prepared to defend your bases. A strong ground army with Medivac support is versatile and can respond to threats.
nodes.title: Midgame Ground Army with Air Support
nodes.transition_goal: Reach a strong midgame position with a capable army and good defense against harassment.
nodes.trigger_summary: At around 420-480 seconds, you have a strong ground army (Marines, Medivacs) and heavy tech. Enemy is on a ground macro posture with Warp Prisms, indicating possible harassment or drops.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid clumping your army and making it vulnerable to Psionic Storm. Do not neglect scouting to detect tech switches.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue strengthening your ground army and tech. Consider adding Ghosts or other units to counter High Templars. Maintain your defensive posture.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have more information about enemy tech. If you see Colossus, consider adding Vikings.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue developing your army and tech, with a focus on countering the enemy's composition.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy has a heavy economy and production, with a ground army (Zealots, High Templars, Sentries, Warp Prisms). They are likely to have strong spellcasters and a powerful army.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production, with a strong ground army and heavy defense. Your air presence is moderate, and you are expanding.
nodes.strategic_reason: High Templars can be devastating with Psionic Storm, so you need to have a plan to deal with them. Ghosts with EMP can be very effective. Your Siege Tanks provide good zone control.
nodes.title: Late-Midgame Ground Army with Heavy Tech
nodes.transition_goal: Reach a strong late-game position with a composition that can handle the enemy's spellcasters.
nodes.trigger_summary: At around 600 seconds, you have a heavy ground army (Siege Tanks, Marines, Marauders) and heavy tech. Enemy is on a ground macro posture with High Templars and Sentries, indicating a strong late-game composition.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid neglecting your ground army entirely. Do not over-invest in anti-air without a clear threat.
nodes.decision_direction: Consider adding anti-air units (e.g., Marines, Thors, Vikings) and possibly a few Medivacs for mobility. Maintain your ground army but be prepared to defend against air attacks.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the enemy's air composition. If they go for a heavy air army, consider more anti-air.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue developing your army and tech, with a focus on countering the enemy's air presence.

nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production, with a ground army and moderate defense. Your air presence is light.
nodes.strategic_reason: Phoenix and Oracle harassment can be very annoying, so you need to have a way to deal with them. Marines are good anti-air, and Thors can provide strong defense.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame vs Air Transition
nodes.transition_goal: Reach a balanced composition that can handle both air and ground threats.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being caught off guard by the air army. Do not neglect scouting to detect tech switches.

nodes.next_state_summary: Continue developing your army and tech, with a focus on anti-air.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy has a heavy economy and production, with an air army (Stalkers, Sentries, Phoenixes, Immortals). They are likely to have a strong air force.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production, with a ground army and heavy defense. Your air presence is moderate.
nodes.strategic_reason: A heavy air army can be very strong, so you need to have a solid anti-air defense. Marines are cost-effective, and Thors can provide heavy damage.
nodes.title: Midgame vs Heavy Air
nodes.transition_goal: Reach a position where you can defend against the enemy's air army and potentially counter-attack.
nodes.trigger_summary: At around 540 seconds, you have a ground army (Marines, Marauders) and heavy tech. Enemy has a heavy air presence with Phoenixes and Immortals.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being too passive and allowing the enemy to harass you. Do not neglect scouting to detect drops or tech switches.
nodes.decision_direction: Maintain your ground army and consider adding more anti-air units. Use Widow Mines to protect your bases from harassment. Continue teching up.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the enemy's composition. If they go for a heavy air army, consider more anti-air.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue developing your army and tech, with a focus on defense and countering the enemy's harassment.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy has a heavy economy and production, with an air army (Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, Phoenixes). They are likely to use Phoenix harassment.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production, with a ground army and moderate air presence. Your defense is heavy.
nodes.strategic_reason: Phoenix harassment can be very effective, so you need to have a way to deal with it. Widow Mines can be very good against Phoenixes if placed well.

nodes.transition_goal: Reach a strong late-game position with a composition that can handle the enemy's air harassment.

opening.opening_summary: A macro-oriented Terran opening that prioritizes economy and technology while maintaining a flexible ground-leaning army. The build aims to develop a strong economic and technological foundation before committing to a specific army composition, allowing adaptation based on scouting information.
